summary.text: Pam Curtis is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 32 since March 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She was first appointed to the seat by Democratic precinct committee members, and her background includes work as chief of staff for the Kansas City Chamber of Commerce and for a mayor.

paragraphs.text: Pam Curtis was born in Kansas City and pursued a degree in communications studies at the University of Missouri.
Her professional experience includes serving as chief of staff for the Kansas City Chamber of Commerce, the Kansas City Area Transportation Authority, and Mayor Joe Reardon.
Curtis was first appointed to the Kansas House by a vote of Democratic precinct committee members on March 3, 2014, filling a vacancy left by the late Michael Peterson.
For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget, Appropriations, House Judiciary, and Information Technology committees.
